name: David Lowery
bio: David Lowery (born December 26, 1980) is an American filmmaker, known for directing independent films such as Ain't Them Bodies Saints, A Ghost Story, The Old Man & the Gun, and The Green Knight, as well as mainstream studio productions such as Pete's Dragon and Peter Pan & Wendy.

credits.title: The Invisible Life of Addie Larue
credits.overview: A film based on the novel of the same name. Follows a woman who makes a Faustian bargain to live forever. But in return, she’s cursed to be forgotten by everyone she meets. That all changes 300 years later, when Addie LaRue stumbles upon a man who remembers her name.

credits.title: The Making of Mother Mary
credits.overview: This feature-length documentary offers an intimate, detailed look at the three-year production process behind the feature film "Mother Mary." It provides a fascinating glimpse behind the scenes — spanning various departments and filming locations — from the costume department and dance rehearsals to sound mixing and th

credits.title: Mother Mary
credits.overview: Long-buried wounds rise to the surface when iconic pop star Mother Mary reunites with her estranged best friend and former costume designer Sam Anselm on the eve of her comeback performance.

credits.title: Messy
credits.overview: Brutally self-aware, promiscuous love addict Stella Fox moves to New York after a devastating break-up and pursues disappointing romantic dalliances over the course of a summer.

credits.title: Queer
credits.overview: In 1950s Mexico City, William Lee, an American ex-pat in his late forties, leads a solitary life amidst a small American community. However, the arrival in town of Eugene Allerton, a young student, stirs William into finally establishing a meaningful connection with someone.

credits.title: An Almost Christmas Story
credits.overview: A young owl meets a lost little girl in New York City. Together, they try to get home for Christmas.

credits.title: Lynch/Oz
credits.overview: Victor Fleming’s 1939 film The Wizard of Oz is one of David Lynch’s most enduring obsessions. This documentary goes over the rainbow to explore this Technicolor through-line in Lynch’s work.

credits.title: Peter Pan & Wendy
credits.overview: Wendy Darling, a young girl afraid to leave her childhood home behind, meets Peter Pan, a boy who refuses to grow up. Alongside her brothers and a tiny fairy, Tinker Bell, she travels with Peter to the magical world of Neverland. There, she encounters an evil pirate captain, Captain Hook, and embarks on a thrilling adv

credits.title: Oak Thorn & the Old Rose of Love
credits.overview: In this companion-piece to The Green Knight, two mysterious entities exchange their knowledge in unconventional ways.

credits.title: The Green Knight Documentary
credits.overview: An hour-long journey behind the scenes of The Green Knight set in Ireland: Come for a look at Dev Patel feeding flowers to a horse, stay for the epic scenery and insight into the filmmaking process.

credits.title: The Year of the Everlasting Storm
credits.overview: Featuring seven stories from seven auteurs from around the world, the film chronicles this unprecedented moment in time, and is a true love letter to the power of cinema and its storytellers.

credits.title: The Green Knight
credits.overview: An epic fantasy adventure based on the timeless Arthurian legend, The Green Knight tells the story of Sir Gawain, King Arthur's reckless and headstrong nephew, who embarks on a daring quest to confront the eponymous Green Knight, a gigantic emerald-skinned stranger and tester of men.

credits.title: Dig Up My Darling
credits.overview: A woman discovers a series of old letters that lead her to the burial site of a beloved son and brother.

credits.title: The Old Man & the Gun
credits.overview: The true story of Forrest Tucker, from his audacious escape from San Quentin at the age of 70 to an unprecedented string of heists that confounded authorities and enchanted the public. credits.title: The Yellow Birds
credits.overview: Two young soldiers, Bartle and Murph, navigate the terrors of the Iraq war under the command of the older, troubled Sergeant Sterling. All the while, Bartle is tortured by a promise he made to Murph's mother before their deployment.

credits.title: A Ghost Story
credits.overview: Recently deceased, a white-sheeted ghost returns to his suburban home to console his bereft wife, only to find that in his spectral state he has become unstuck in time, forced to watch passively as the life he knew and the woman he loves slowly slip away.

credits.title: Pete's Dragon
credits.overview: For years, old wood carver Mr. Meacham has delighted local children with his tales of the fierce dragon that resides deep in the woods of the Pacific Northwest. credits.title: Listen Up Philip
credits.overview: Anger rages in Philip as he awaits the publication of his second novel. He feels pushed out of his adopted home city by the constant crowds and noise, a deteriorating relationship with his photographer girlfriend Ashley, and his own indifference to promoting the novel. credits.title: Until We Could
credits.overview: Until We Could, a gorgeous new video poem written by Richard Blanco, celebrates love and the freedom to marry for same-sex couples. The film is narrated by Golden Globe winning actress Robin Wright and actor Ben Foster.  For more info on the campaign to win marriage nationwide, visits www.freedomtomarry.org.

credits.title: Baby Mary
credits.overview: An eight-year-old girl living on the west side of Chicago finds a neglected toddler and decides to take her home.

credits.title: Ain't Them Bodies Saints
credits.overview: Bob Muldoon and Ruth Guthrie, an impassioned young outlaw couple on an extended crime spree, are finally apprehended by lawmen after a shootout in the Texas hills. credits.title: Sun Don't Shine
credits.overview: Crystal and her boyfriend Leo embark on a tense and mysterious road trip through the desolate yet hauntingly beautiful landscape of central Florida.

credits.title: Upstream Color
credits.overview: A man and woman are drawn together, entangled in the lifecycle of an ageless organism. Identity becomes an illusion as they struggle to assemble the loose fragments of wrecked lives.

credits.title: Pit Stop
credits.overview: Openly gay Ernesto and closeted Gabe grapple with the sad tribulations of being gay in a small, working-class Texas town

credits.title: Nor'easter
credits.overview: A young and inexperienced priest encourages a family to declare their long-missing son dead, but once they do, the boy mysteriously returns, testing the priest's commitment to church doctrine over the laws of the natural world.

credits.title: Reconvergence
credits.overview: Reconvergence offers an intriguing exploration of mortality, consciousness, and identity in the modern age from the perspectives of four distinct characters: a naturalist, a neuroscientist, a poet, and a historian.

credits.title: Empire Builder
credits.overview: Jenny's life has changed significantly since she had a baby. her days of food activism and urban anthropology have been replaced by diapers and playtime at the park. credits.title: Knife
credits.overview: Set in rural Texas the story chronicles an unnamed man with a broken spirit. In the beginning we see him returning to his family. Where he’s been is unknown. credits.title: Universal Squadrons
credits.overview: Captain Lance Deakin has returned home after serving his country in Iraq. In his civilian life, he is a Texan ranch handler who lives with his partner, Becca. Deakin tries to get back into his simple way of life but strange images, memories and flashbacks of the war keep coming back to him.

credits.title: Shadowboxing
credits.overview: An offbeat yet serious family drama about coming home, arrested development and infidelity.

credits.title: Pioneer
credits.overview: A father tells his little boy the most epic bedtime story ever.

credits.title: Cork's Cattlebaron
credits.overview: A young protege and his boss sit down for the most epic steak dinner of their lives in Omaha, Nebraska.

credits.title: Bad Fever
credits.overview: A humorless loner attempts to win the admiration of a drifter with his debut performance at the local comedy club.

credits.title: My Daily Routine
credits.overview: It is all in the title. MY DAILY ROUTINE is a playful visual diary of filmmaker David Lowery's days, from waking in the morning to turning in at night, when his racing mind refuses to let him sleep without working over a new creative project or reading until the wee hours. credits.title: Audrey the Trainwreck
credits.overview: The story of two people caught in the routines of work and circles of friends. The days begin with an alarm and end with the fading sound of a television. credits.title: Lovers of Hate
credits.overview: Two rival brothers engage in the ultimate challenge when they compete for the affections of the same woman.

credits.title: Birthday Suit
credits.overview: A spoof behind-the-scenes look at Joe Swanberg's (non-existent) new film, Birthday Suit, about a young couple's "on again, off again" sexual relationship. The (non-existent) film uses cutting edge technology developed at the WETA Workshop to create the illusion of graphic sexual content.

credits.title: It Was Great, But I Was Ready to Come Home
credits.overview: A young woman from Chicago takes a trip to Costa Rica to recover from life issues, reconnect with a friend, and try to find herself.

credits.title: St. Nick
credits.overview: St. Nick is the story of a brother and sister on the run. They've left their home for some unknown reason and are living in the woods, hiding in barns and sheds, doing what they can to survive. credits.title: Alexander the Last
credits.overview: An ensemble drama about a married actress, her sister and their myriad sexual and creative temptations.

credits.title: Merrily, Merrily
credits.overview: A simple story about a 13-year-old girl in an existential crisis. Her name is Merrilee. She is an only child. Introspective and out of place, her social nexus is nominal.

credits.title: A Catalog of Anticipations
credits.overview: A woman drifts back to childhood memories of rural Texas where her discovery of the jawbone of a horse in a field leads to a fascination with, in her own words, "dead things." Her natural history collection of insects and bones takes on a supernatural quality when she finds the corpse of a strange creature that she bel

credits.title: Boycrazy
credits.overview: A series of vignettes about awkward romantic encounters.

credits.title: A Delineation
credits.overview: A short remembrance of waiting in line to see the last Star Wars movie.

credits.title: The Outlaw Son
credits.overview: A young man calls an old friend to pick him up from the airport. She does so, and they spend a long cold night in each other's company; driving around, listening to music, and trying hard not to grow up.

credits.title: Some Analog Lines
credits.overview: Some Analog Lines is a playfully philosophical, surprisingly personal essay film that examines the dichotomy between digital technology and the artistic process of filmmaking. credits.title: LOL
credits.overview: The relationships of three men are examined through their use of technology.

credits.title: Deadroom
credits.overview: Four encounters, each confined to a single room: a man helps a young woman remember her past; a husband and wife confront each other about their infidelities; a journalist interviews a famous author about the mysteries hidden in his novel; and a secretary visits her former employer to tell him how much she's always lov

credits.title: Looking For Love
credits.overview: "Looking For Love" by David Lowery was shot in a fit of inspiration over the course of two hours on Valentine's Day in 2003. It took another two hours to clean up afterwards.

credits.title: Still
credits.overview: A successful young couple finds their happy marriage unhinged by a disturbing secret.
